layers.name: Policy
layers.purpose: Define principles, permitted use, approval gates and regulatory alignment.

layers.name: Roles & Accountability
layers.purpose: Assign accountable owners, decision rights, legal oversight and escalation.

layers.name: Risk Management
layers.purpose: Identify, classify, assess, mitigate and explicitly treat residual AI risk.

layers.name: Data & Model Governance
layers.purpose: Govern data, prompts, models, providers, lineage, versions, access and retention.

layers.name: Monitoring & Controls
layers.purpose: Monitor performance, bias, drift, security, incidents and continuous control operation.

layers.name: Audit & Assurance
layers.purpose: Preserve evidence, test controls, audit governance, track remediation and support independent assurance.

interpretation: Layer status is derived from control-register status plus repository evidence-path validation.
GRC signals are copied from the separately generated data/grc-metrics.json snapshot.
Green repository evidence does not imply external certification or completion of human approvals.
